about.title: Sports Performance Coach
about.bio: I work with athletes across all sports and skill levels to build the physical and mental qualities that translate directly to better performance. My holistic approach addresses strength, movement quality, injury prevention, and the mental side of competing at your best.

hero.headline: Peak Performance. Every Season.
hero.subline: Sports performance coaching — athletic development, movement quality, and injury resilience for athletes who want to perform at their best year-round.

packages.title: In-Season Performance
packages.description: Maintain your gains and stay explosive during your competitive season — 2 sessions per week focused on recovery, movement quality, and controlled power work.

packages.title: Off-Season Development
packages.description: Complete 16-week off-season program — movement screening, strength building, power development, and speed work tailored to your sport and position.

packages.title: Elite Athlete Program
packages.description: Year-round programming for serious athletes — periodized training blocks, ongoing monitoring, nutrition guidance, and priority access for scheduling.

faq.question: What makes sports performance different from a typical gym program?
faq.answer: Sports performance training is intentionally designed around your sport, season, and position — not generic fitness goals. Every decision is made with your athletic performance in mind.

faq.question: What is an FMS screening?
faq.answer: The Functional Movement Screen (FMS) is a 7-movement assessment that identifies mobility restrictions and asymmetries that can lead to injury or limit performance.

faq.question: Where do sessions take place?
faq.answer: Training takes place at a fully equipped performance facility. Location is confirmed at booking.

faq.question: Can you work with injured athletes?
faq.answer: I work alongside physical therapists and athletic trainers on return-to-sport programming. I do not treat injuries — I build performance and resilience.

faq.question: What age groups do you train?
faq.answer: High school athletes (14+) through professional level. Programs are always age and maturity-appropriate.
